title: ToolCommand

items.description: One argument, given to the program as one word whatever it holds; never a control character.
A program and its arguments, as a fixed list: the first is the program.
One step of a command: its programs, each one's output piped into the next.

description: An install or update command as fixed argument lists: its steps, each run once the one before it has succeeded; never a fetched string or a shell line.
